INSTALL_SETTINGS_SAVE_FAILED: Server files installed, but some install settings ({{fields}}) could not be saved ({{reason}}). Re-check them under Settings once the panel is back up.
INI_PRECREATED_WITH_RCON: Pre-created server INI with RCON credentials
INSTALL_RCON_INI_PRECREATE_FAILED: Could not pre-write the RCON password into the server config ({{reason}}). This is retried automatically the next time you start the server, so no action is needed unless it happens again.
INI_PRECREATED_WITH_UPNP: Pre-created server INI with UPnP setting
INSTALL_STARTUP_SCRIPT_FAILED: Could not generate this server's custom startup script ({{reason}}). The server can still be started — it will use the default script until this regenerates, which also happens automatically the next time you start it.
INSTALL_MISSING_GAME_FILES: SteamCMD reported success, but no recognizable game files were found at the install path. Check the SteamCMD log above for a hidden error (a rate limit or an interrupted download can still exit 0), and verify the install path before starting this server.
INSTALL_WATCHDOG_KILLED: Installation was stopped after {{minutes}} minutes with no output from SteamCMD — it may have stalled or lost its connection. Try again.
STEAM_DEPOT_ACCESS_DENIED: SteamCMD could not access a Project Zomboid depot manifest. Your installed server files were not changed. Retry later; if it persists, update using a Steam account that owns Project Zomboid.
STEAMCMD_DOWNLOAD_FAILED_LINUX: Download failed: {{reason}}. Ensure curl or wget is installed.
STEAMCMD_32BIT_LIB_WARNING: Warning: Could not verify 32-bit libraries. If SteamCMD fails, install: yum install glibc.i686 libstdc++.i686 (CentOS/RHEL) or apt install lib32gcc-s1 (Debian/Ubuntu)
